title: Vincent van Gogh
subtitle: A life in light and color

milestones.title: Born in Zundert
milestones.description: Vincent Willem van Gogh is born on 30 March 1853 in Zundert, Netherlands — the eldest son of a Protestant pastor.

milestones.title: Art Dealer at Goupil & Cie
milestones.description: At 16, Vincent begins working for the art dealership Goupil & Cie in The Hague, later transferred to London and Paris.

milestones.title: Love Letters to Ursula
milestones.description: Stationed in London, Vincent falls deeply in love with Ursula Loyer. His unrequited love marks the beginning of his emotional turbulence.

milestones.title: Decision to Become an Artist
milestones.description: At 27, after failed careers in art dealing, teaching, and ministry, Vincent finally commits to becoming an artist.

milestones.title: The Dark Period — Netherlands
milestones.description: Working in The Hague and Nuenen, Vincent develops his somber palette. Creates 'The Potato Eaters' (1885), his first masterpiece.

milestones.title: Arrival in Paris
milestones.description: Vincent moves to Paris, joins his brother Theo, and discovers Impressionism. His palette transforms from dark earth tones to vibrant color.

milestones.title: The Yellow House — Arles
milestones.description: Vincent moves to Arles in southern France, dreaming of an artists' colony. Paints the Sunflowers series and the Yellow House.

milestones.title: Gauguin & The Ear
milestones.description: Paul Gauguin joins Vincent in Arles. After a violent argument, Vincent cuts off part of his own ear. Gauguin leaves.

milestones.title: The Starry Night
milestones.description: From the asylum at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, Vincent paints 'The Starry Night' — arguably the most recognized painting in the world.

milestones.title: Auvers-sur-Oise & Wheat Field
milestones.description: Vincent moves to Auvers-sur-Oise, painting prolifically — 70 paintings in 70 days. Creates 'Wheatfield with Crows'.

milestones.title: Death at 37
milestones.description: On 27 July 1890, Vincent shoots himself in a wheat field. He dies two days later, with Theo at his side. He sold only one painting in his lifetime.
